## 1. New LLM Versions / Major AI Lab Tools

- **Date:** 2026-08-23  
  **Link:** [OpenAI — Replit expands access to software creation with GPT‑5.6 Luna](https://openai.com/index/replit/)  
  **Summary:** Replit is expanding free access to software creation using GPT‑5.6 Luna, positioning the model as an agentic coding layer for turning ideas into working apps without token-cost friction for users.  
  **Why it matters:** Lowers the barrier to AI-native software creation and increases distribution of closed frontier coding models through developer platforms.

- **Date:** 2026-08-23  
  **Link:** [OpenAI — ChatGPT Ads expands across Europe](https://openai.com/index/chatgpt-ads-expands-across-europe/)  
  **Summary:** OpenAI says ChatGPT Ads is expanding to 31 European markets, giving advertisers access to users during search, comparison, and decision workflows inside ChatGPT.  
  **Why it matters:** Signals continued commercialization of assistant surfaces and increases regulatory/brand-safety exposure in Europe.

- **Date:** 2026-08-23  
  **Link:** [OpenAI — Offering Zero Data Retention for frontier models](https://openai.com/index/offering-zero-data-retention-for-frontier-models/)  
  **Summary:** OpenAI reaffirmed Zero Data Retention availability for eligible API customers and previewed Private Safety Processing for safety analysis without retaining customer data.  
  **Why it matters:** Directly addresses enterprise blockers around frontier-model adoption: data retention, privacy controls, and safety monitoring tradeoffs.

- **Date:** 2026-08-23  
  **Link:** [OpenAI Help Center — ChatGPT Business release notes](https://help.openai.com/en/articles/11391654-chatgpt-business-release-notes)  
  **Summary:** OpenAI’s Business release notes direct coding-focused users toward GPT‑5‑Codex in Codex-like environments and GPT‑5 for general non-coding work.
